sections.title: MEANING IN CONTEXT
sections.instruction: Use the surrounding sentence to work out the meaning of the underlined word.

sections.title: SYNONYMS AND ANTONYMS
sections.instruction: Choose the word that has the closest or opposite meaning, as requested.

sections.title: WORD FORMATION
sections.instruction: Choose the correct form of the word in brackets to complete each sentence.

sections.title: COLLOCATIONS AND PHRASAL VERBS
sections.instruction: Choose the word combination or phrasal verb that is natural in English.

sections.title: EXPRESSIONS AND COMMONLY CONFUSED WORDS
sections.instruction: Pay attention to the meaning and natural use of the expression or word in each sentence.

questions.prompt: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor concert continued as scheduled. The word “continued” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “continued as scheduled” berarti acara tetap berlangsung sesuai rencana. Kalimat menunjukkan bahwa hujan deras tidak menghentikan konser.

questions.prompt: The instructions were so vague that several students did not know what to do. The word “vague” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “vague” berarti tidak jelas atau kurang terperinci. Petunjuknya adalah beberapa siswa tidak tahu apa yang harus dilakukan.

questions.prompt: The scientist examined the sample carefully before recording the results. The word “examined” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “examined” berarti memeriksa dengan teliti. Dalam kalimat, ilmuwan memeriksa sampel sebelum mencatat hasilnya.

questions.prompt: The old bridge is fragile, so heavy vehicles are not allowed to cross it. The word “fragile” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “fragile” berarti rapuh atau mudah rusak. Petunjuknya adalah kendaraan berat tidak boleh melewati jembatan tersebut.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “generous”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “generous” berarti murah hati atau suka memberi. “Charitable” memiliki makna yang paling dekat, yaitu suka membantu atau memberi kepada orang lain.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “reluctant”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “reluctant” berarti enggan atau tidak bersedia melakukan sesuatu. “Unwilling” memiliki arti yang sama.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “scarce”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “scarce” berarti langka atau jumlahnya sedikit, sedangkan “abundant” berarti melimpah atau tersedia dalam jumlah banyak.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “expand”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “expand” berarti memperluas atau membesar, sedangkan “shrink” berarti menyusut atau mengecil.

questions.prompt: The school encourages students to act ______ when they see bullying. (RESPONSIBLE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Kata tersebut menjelaskan cara siswa bertindak. Kita membutuhkan adverb (kata keterangan), yaitu “responsibly”, bukan adjective atau noun.

questions.prompt: Her ______ to the project helped the team finish early. (CONTRIBUTE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Bagian kosong membutuhkan noun (kata benda) setelah “her”. “Contribution” berarti sumbangan atau kontribusi yang diberikan seseorang.

questions.prompt: The instructions were ______, so everyone understood what to do. (CLEAR)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “were” dibutuhkan adjective (kata sifat) untuk menjelaskan “the instructions”. Bentuk adjective dari “clear” tetap “clear”.

questions.prompt: We were impressed by the ______ of the mountain view. (BEAUTIFUL)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “the” dan sebelum “of” dibutuhkan noun. “Beauty” adalah kata benda yang berarti keindahan.

questions.prompt: Please ______ your shoes before entering the room.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “take off” berarti melepas. Dalam konteks ini, seseorang diminta melepas sepatu sebelum masuk ruangan.

questions.prompt: The meeting was ______ because the manager was ill.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “put off” berarti menunda. Rapat ditunda karena manajer sedang sakit.

questions.prompt: She is looking ______ her younger brother while their parents are away.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “look after” berarti menjaga atau merawat seseorang. Kalimat menjelaskan bahwa ia menjaga adiknya saat orang tua mereka pergi.

questions.prompt: The charity hopes to ______ awareness about plastic waste among local residents.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Pasangan kata yang alami dalam bahasa Inggris adalah “raise awareness”, yang berarti meningkatkan kesadaran masyarakat tentang suatu masalah.

questions.prompt: Although he was nervous, he managed to ______ his point clearly during the discussion.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Expression.

Penjelasan: “get a point across” berarti menyampaikan gagasan agar orang lain memahaminya. Kalimat menyebutkan bahwa ia berhasil menyampaikan pendapatnya dengan jelas.

questions.prompt: The new timetable will take effect next Monday. The phrase “take effect” means ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expression in Context.

Penjelasan: “take effect” berarti mulai berlaku atau mulai diterapkan. Jadi, jadwal baru mulai digunakan pada hari Senin depan.

questions.prompt: The school principal gave us useful ______ about choosing subjects for next year.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: “advice” berarti nasihat dan merupakan uncountable noun (kata benda yang tidak dihitung satu per satu). Karena itu, bentuk “advices” tidak tepat dalam kalimat ini.

questions.prompt: The medicine had an immediate ______ on his headache.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: “effect” adalah noun yang berarti dampak atau pengaruh. Kalimat membutuhkan kata benda setelah “an immediate”. “Affect” biasanya digunakan sebagai verb.
